title: Final acceleration value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the correct numerical acceleration of block A (5 m/s²) when block B is about to leave the ground.

title: Final displacement value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the correct numerical displacement of block A (0.125 m) from the initial position to the moment block B leaves the ground.

title: Spring force condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify that when block B is about to leave the ground, the spring force equals the weight of block B (30 N).

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law to block A, accounting for the applied force, spring force, and gravity to find acceleration.

title: Initial spring compression
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the initial compression of the spring from the equilibrium of block A's weight (0.05 m).

title: Final spring extension
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the spring extension when block B is about to leave the ground using Hooke's Law and the spring force (0.075 m).

title: Displacement from spring lengths
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly sum the initial compression and final extension to find the total displacement of block A.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns signs to forces (e.g., treating upward spring force as negative when applying Newton's law) or miscalculates displacement direction.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (m/s², m) or if intermediate calculations use inconsistent units (e.g., cm instead of m).
